review.why: Turns a job description and a background into a tailored, ATS-aware resume with gap analysis and cover letter hooks.
review.summary: Step-by-step flow to tailor a resume to a job posting: gather the background, extract and rank the requirements, map experience, structure each section, optimize for ATS, then add gap analysis, interview tips and cover letter hooks. One full worked example.
strengths: Complete ordered workflow from job analysis to iteration
Tells the agent never to fabricate experience
Special cases: career changers, graduates, executives, creative roles
cautions: Instructions only: no scripts or reference files
The worked example uses invented sample data
Some advice is US-specific (no references, one page)
